summary: The Throne of Underfoot is the divine seat of Brell Serilis, where stone, crystal, and magma converge into pure subterranean authority. Brell’s Divine Aspect manifests here to judge mortals who reach the heart of Underfoot.
history: The Throne was shaped from the first stone Brell ever touched.
Crystal roots and magma flows converge here in perfect divine harmony.
Stone guardians were forged to protect the sanctum.
Only the most attuned mortals may stand before Brell’s Divine Aspect.
